I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the site was **Southgate**.

The answer comes from that channel. On 2025-09-03 Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked by door 4. Later that day she posted that it was fixed and Southgate had cleared the backlog. I couldn't find an address or any other site details in the channel or the shared files, and I told Tobias that.
